ayahs.arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.translit: Tabaraka allathee biyadihi almulku wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ أَيُّكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلࣰ اۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفُورُ
ayahs.translit: Allathee khalaqa almawta waalhayata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu AAamalan wahuwa alAAazeezu alghafooru

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ طِبَاقࣰ اۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتࣲۖ فَٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ هَلۡ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Allathee khalaqa sabAAa samawatin tibaqan ma tara fee khalqi alrrahmani min tafawutin fairjiAAi albasara hal tara min futoorin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيۡنِ يَنقَلِبۡ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ خَاسِئࣰ ا وَهُوَ حَسِيرࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Thumma irjiAAi albasara karratayni yanqalib ilayka albasaru khasian wahuwa haseerun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا رُجُومࣰ ا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bimasabeeha wajaAAalnaha rujooman lilshshayateeni waaAAtadna lahum AAathaba alssaAAeeri

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze

ayahs.arabic: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
ayahs.translit: Walillatheena kafaroo birabbihim AAathabu jahannama wabisa almaseeru

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination

ayahs.arabic: إِذَآ أُلۡقُواْ فِيهَا سَمِعُواْ لَهَا شَهِيقࣰ ا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ
ayahs.translit: Itha olqoo feeha samiAAoo laha shaheeqan wahiya tafooru

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up

ayahs.arabic: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيۡظِۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلۡقِيَ فِيهَا فَوۡجࣱ سَأَلَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَذِيرࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Takadu tamayyazu mina alghaythi kullama olqiya feeha fawjun saalahum khazanatuha alam yatikum natheerun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرࣱ فَكَذَّبۡنَا وَقُلۡنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ كَبِيرࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Qaloo bala qad jaana natheerun fakaththabna waqulna ma nazzala Allahu min shayin in antum illa fee dalalin kabeerin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ كُنَّا نَسۡمَعُ أَوۡ نَعۡقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِيٓ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.translit: Waqaloo law kunna nasmaAAu aw naAAqilu ma kunna fee ashabi alssaAAeeri

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze

ayahs.arabic: فَٱعۡتَرَفُواْ بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسُحۡقࣰ ا لِّأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.translit: FaiAAtarafoo bithanbihim fasuhqan liashabi alssaAAeeri

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةࣱ وَأَجۡرࣱ كَبِيرࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Inna allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi lahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeerun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward

ayahs.arabic: وَأَسِرُّواْ قَوۡلَكُمۡ أَوِ ٱجۡهَرُواْ بِهِۦٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.translit: Waasirroo qawlakum awi ijharoo bihi innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts

ayahs.arabic: أَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ
ayahs.translit: Ala yaAAlamu man khalaqa wahuwa allateefu alkhabeeru

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted

ayahs.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ ذَلُولࣰ ا فَٱمۡشُواْ فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُواْ مِن رِّزۡقِهِۦۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
ayahs.translit: Huwa allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda thaloolan faimshoo fee manakibiha wakuloo min rizqihi wailayhi alnnushooru

t.eng-ummmuhammad: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection

ayahs.arabic: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخۡسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ
ayahs.translit: Aamintum man fee alssamai an yakhsifa bikumu alarda faitha hiya tamooru

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبࣰ اۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ كَيۡفَ نَذِيرِ
ayahs.translit: Am amintum man fee alssamai an yursila AAalaykum hasiban fasataAAlamoona kayfa natheeri

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad kaththaba allatheena min qablihim fakayfa kana nakeeri

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّيۡرِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ صَٰٓفَّٰتࣲ وَيَقۡبِضۡنَۚ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءِۭ بَصِيرٌ
ayahs.translit: Awalam yaraw ila alttayri fawqahum saffatin wayaqbidna ma yumsikuhunna illa alrrahmanu innahu bikulli shayin baseerun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ جُندࣱ لَّكُمۡ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ إِنِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ
ayahs.translit: Amman hatha allathee huwa jundun lakum yansurukum min dooni alrrahmani ini alkafiroona illa fee ghuroorin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي يَرۡزُقُكُمۡ إِنۡ أَمۡسَكَ رِزۡقَهُۥۚ بَل لَّجُّواْ فِي عُتُوࣲّ وَنُفُورٍ
ayahs.translit: Amman hatha allathee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqahu bal lajjoo fee AAutuwwin wanufoorin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion

ayahs.arabic: أَفَمَن يَمۡشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِهِۦٓ أَهۡدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمۡشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطࣲ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Afaman yamshee mukibban AAala wajhihi ahda amman yamshee sawiyyan AAala siratin mustaqeemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَكُمۡ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qul huwa allathee anshaakum wajaAAala lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qul huwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered

ayahs.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡعِلۡمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Qul innama alAAilmu AAinda Allahi wainnama ana natheerun mubeenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهُ زُلۡفَةࣰ سِيٓـَٔتۡ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Falamma raawhu zulfatan seeat wujoohu allatheena kafaroo waqeela hatha allathee kuntum bihi taddaAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَهۡلَكَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوۡ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Qul araaytum in ahlakaniya Allahu waman maAAiya aw rahimana faman yujeeru alkafireena min AAathabin aleemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡنَاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Qul huwa alrrahmanu amanna bihi waAAalayhi tawakkalna fasataAAlamoona man huwa fee dalalin mubeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَصۡبَحَ مَآؤُكُمۡ غَوۡرࣰ ا فَمَن يَأۡتِيكُم بِمَآءࣲ مَّعِينِۭ
ayahs.translit: Qul araaytum in asbaha maokum ghawran faman yateekum bimain maAAeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water
